{"content":""""Reportes: Markdown a partir de tareas y summary."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from .models import Task, VALID_PRIORITIES, VALID_STATUSES


def _esc(value: Any) -> str:
    text = "" if value is None else str(value)
    return text.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")


def markdown_report(tasks: list[Task], summary: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []
    lines.append("# TaskFlow Ultra Report")
    lines.append("")
    total = summary.get("total", len(tasks))
    lines.append(f"Total de tareas: **{total}**")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Conteos por estado")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| Estado | Cantidad |")
    lines.append("| --- | ---: |")
    by_status = summary.get("by_status", {})
    for status in VALID_STATUSES:
        lines.append(f"| {status} | {by_status.get(status, 0)} |")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Conteos por prioridad")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| Prioridad | Cantidad |")
    lines.append("| --- | ---: |")
    by_priority = summary.get("by_priority", {})
    for priority in VALID_PRIORITIES:
        lines.append(f"| {priority} | {by_priority.get(priority, 0)} |")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Métricas")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"- Overdue: {summary.get('overdue', 0)}")
    lines.append(f"- Blocked: {summary.get('blocked', 0)}")
    lines.append(f"- Ready: {summary.get('ready', 0)}")
    lines.append("")

    blocked = [t for t in tasks if t.status not in ("done", "cancelled") and t.depends_on]
    lines.append("## Tareas bloqueadas")
    lines.append("")
    if blocked:
        lines.append("| ID | Título | Deps pendientes |")
        lines.append("| --- | --- | --- |")
        for task in blocked:
            lines.append(
                f"| {task.id} | {_esc(task.title)} | {_esc(', '.join(str(d) for d in task.depends_on))} |"
            )
    else:
        lines.append("_Sin tareas bloqueadas._")
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("## Tareas")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("| ID | Título | Estado | Prioridad | Tags | Due |")
    lines.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")
    for task in tasks:
        lines.append(
            "| {id} hold | hold | hold | hold | hold | hold |".format(
                id=task.id
            ).replace("hold", "")
            if False
            else f"| {task.id} | {_esc(task.title)} | {task.status} | {task.priority} | {_esc(', '.join(task.tags))} | {_esc(task.due_date)} |"
        )
    lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines)

import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from .cli import run_cli
from .service import TaskService
from .storage import JsonTaskStorage


def _self_test() -> int:
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            storage = JsonTaskStorage(Path(tmp) / "tasks.json")
            service = TaskService(storage)

            a = service.create_task("Diseñar API", "spec", "high", ["Backend", "backend"])
            b = service.create_task("Implementar API", "api impl", "medium", ["backend"],
                                    depends_on=[a.id])
            assert a.tags == ["backend"], a.tags

            # bloqueo por dependencia
            try:
                service.complete_task(b.id)
                return 1
            except ValueError:
                pass

            service.complete_task(a.id)
            service.complete_task(b.id)
            assert service.get_task(b.id).status == "done"
            assert service.get_task(b.id).completed_at

            # recurrencia
            c = service.create_task("Daily standup", "", "medium", ["team"],
                                    due_date="2026-01-31", recurrence="monthly")
            service.complete_task(c.id)
            nxt = service.get_task(c.id + 1)
            assert nxt.title == "Daily standup" and nxt.status == "todo"
            assert nxt.due_date == "2026-02-28", nxt.due_date

            # ciclos
            d = service.create_task("Tarea D")
            e = service.create_task("Tarea E")
            service.add_dependency(d.id, e.id)
            try:
                service.add_dependency(e.id, d.id)
                return 1
            except ValueError:
                pass

            # undo
            before = service.get_task(d.id).hold if False else service.get_task(d.id).status
            assert service.undo() is True
            assert service.get_task(d.id).status == before

            # ready / blocked
            f = service.create_task("Bloqueada", "", "low", [], depends_on=[e.id])
            assert service.blocked_by(f.id) == [e.id]
            assert f.id not in [t.id for t in service.ready_tasks()]

            # persistencia + ids crecientes
            common = TaskService(JsonTaskStorage(Path(tmp) / "tasks.json"))
            assert common.get_task(a.id).title == "Diseñar API"
            g = common.create_task("Nueva")
            assert g.id > max(t.id for t in common.sorted_tasks() if t.id != g.id)

            # JSON corrupto
            (Path(tmp) / "bad.json").write_text("{no es json", encoding="utf-8")
            assert JsonTaskStorage(Path(tmp) / "bad.json").load() == []

            # export
            service.export_markdown(Path(tmp) / "report.md")
            service.export_csv(Path(tmp) / "tasks.csv")
            assert (Path(tmp) / "report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").startswith("# TaskFlow")
            assert "id,title" in (Path(tmp) / "tasks.csv").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

            summary = service.summary()
            for key in ("total", "by_status", "by_priority", "overdue", "blocked", "ready"):
                assert key in summary
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - self-test debe reportar
        print(f"SELF_TEST_FAIL: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("SELF_TEST_OK")
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    argv = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    if "--self-test" in argv:
        return _self_test()
    storage_path = argv[0] if argv else "taskflow_data.json"
    service = TaskService(JsonTaskStorage(storage_path))
    try:
        run_cli(service)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nSalida cancelada.")
        return 0
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path

from taskflow_ultra import TaskService, JsonTaskStorage, Task
from taskflow_ultra.main import main
from taskflow_ultra.query import apply_query, parse_query
from taskflow_ultra.reports import markdown_report
from taskflow_ultra.scheduler import next_occurrence


class BaseCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self._tmp.name) / "tasks.json"
        self.service = TaskService(JsonTaskStorage(self.path))


class TestModel(BaseCase):
    def test_create_and_defaults(self) -> None:
        task = self.service.create_task("  Escribir tests  ", "unit", "high")
        self.assertEqual(task hold hold if False else task.id, 1)
        self.assertEqual(task.title, "Escribir tests")
        self.assertEqual(task.status, "todo")
        self.assertEqual(
            set(task.to_dict()),
            {
                "id", "title", "description", "priority", "status", "tags",
                "depends_on", "recurrence", "created_at", "updated_at",
                "due_date", "completed_at",
            },
        )

    def test_tags_normalized_case_insensitive_dedup(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(Task(1, "x", tags=["Backend", "backend", " QA ", "qa", ""]).tags, ["backend", "qa"])

    def test_empty_title_raises(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.create_task("   ")

    def test_invalid_priority_status_recurrence(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.create_task("t", priority="critical")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.create_task("t", recurrence="yearly")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.set_status(self.service.create_task("t").id, "paused")

    def test_get_task_missing_raises_keyerror(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            self.service.get_task(999)

    def test_to_dict_from_dict_symmetric(self) -> None:
        common = self.service.create_task(
            "Informe", "desc", "urgent", ["A", "b"], "2026-03-05", None, "weekly"
        )
        restored = Task.from_dict(common.to_dict())
        self.assertEqual(restored.to_dict(), common.to_dict())


class TestDependencies(BaseCase):
    def test_dependency_blocks_complete(self) -> None:
        a = self.service.create_task("A")
        b = self.service.create_task("B", depends_on=[a.id])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.complete_task(b.id)
        self.service.complete_task(a.id)
        self.service.complete_task(b.id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.service.get_task(b.id).completed_at)

    def test_cycle_detection(self) -> None:
        a = self.service.create_task("A")
        b = self.service.create_task("B")
        c = self.service.create_task("C")
        self.service.add_dependency(a.id, b.id)
        self.service.add_dependency(b.id, c.id)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.add_dependency(c.id, a.id)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.add_dependency(a.id, a.id)

    def test_unknown_dependency_raises_keyerror(self) -> None:
        self.service.create_task("A")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            self.service.add_dependency(1, 404)
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            self.service.create_task("B", depends_on=[404])

    def test_blocked_by_and_ready(self) -> None:
        a = self.service.create_task("A")
        b = self.service.create_task("B", depends_on=[a.id])
        self.assertEqual(self.service.blocked_by(b.id), [a.id])
        ready_ids = [t.id for t in self.service.ready_tasks()]
        self.assertIn(a.id, ready_ids)
        self.assertNotIn(b.id, ready_ids)
        self.service.complete_task(a.id)
        self.assertEqual(self.service.blocked_by(b.id), [])
        self.assertIn(b.id, [t.id for t in self.service.ready_tasks()])


class TestRecurrence(BaseCase):
    def test_complete_recurrence_creates_next(self) -> None:
        task = self.service.create_task("Standup", due_date="2026-01-10", recurrence="daily")
        self.service.complete_task(task.id)
        nxt = self.service.get_task(task.id + 1)
        self.assertEqual(nxt.title, "Standup")
        self.assertEqual(nxt.status, "todo")
        self.assertIsNone(nxt.completed_at)
        self.assertEqual(nxt.due_date, "2026-01-11")

    def test_next_occurrence_monthly_clamp(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(next_occurrence("2026-01-31", "monthly"), "2026-02-28")
        self.assertEqual(next_occurrence("2024-01-31", "monthly"), "2024-02-29")
        self.assertEqual(next_occurrence("2026-01-15T09:30:00+00:00", "weekly"), "2026-01-22")
        self.assertEqual(next_occurrence("2026-02-28", "daily"), "2026-03-01")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            next_occurrence("2026-02-28", "biweekly")


class TestLifecycleUndo(BaseCase):
    def test_reopen_and_cancel(self) -> None:
        self.service.create_task("A")
        self.service.complete_task(1)
        self.service.reopen_task(1)
        task = self.service.get_task(1)
        self.assertEqual(task.status, "todo")
        self.assertIsNone(task.completed_at)
        self.service.cancel_task(1)
        self.assertEqual(self.service.get_task(1).status, "cancelled")

    def test_undo_reverts_last_mutation(self) -> None:
        self.service.create_task("A")
        self.service.update_task(1, priority="urgent")
        self.assertEqual(self.service.get_task(1).priority, "urgent")
        self.assertTrue(self.service.undo())
        self.assertEqual(self.service.get_task(1).priority, "medium")
        self.assertTrue(self.service.undo())  # revierte la creación
        self.assertFalse(self.service.undo())
